high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "get.waste.ed," which is described as "Russia state-controlled media." The post includes a tweet by Sarah Goodyear (@buttermilk1) that discusses the impact of urban development on flash floods. The tweet states: "All those roads and parking spaces we love to build are contributing to flash floods: 'Every time a city expands roads, sidewalks or parking lots by one percentage point, the annual flood magnitude in nearby waterways increases by 3.3 percent.
